roles.name: 集成与治理
roles.goal: 交付可接续架构/科学指标/迁移方案及治理验证，再协调正式产品分工
roles.done_when: 当前任务满足cursor退出条件，精确证据和下一阶段边界齐全

roles.name: 运行时与内存
roles.goal: R1-M1-STOP-LOAN-GENERATION-006: Within existing M1 runtime and owned tests, prove one owner-scoped generation transition safely drains preallocated <=32 TX and RX ready batches, old-generation callbacks cannot resubmit already-frozen ciphertext, first fresh on a new scope not blocked by late loan returns, and stop/borrow fences give exact last-loan ownership. No syscall, external dependency or source of authentication.
roles.done_when: Own SOURCE compiled-once native r1_ tests of 0/1/32/33, two lane generations, mixed RX/TX loan returns, ABA/stale owner token, stop during ready and fake-clock expiry, no heap during hot drains and complete prior51/51 tests; own evidence S and cursor-only H Governance.

roles.name: 恢复与反馈
roles.goal: R2-M2-RECEIPT-REVERSE-SCOPE-005: Add pure fail-closed receipt-route admission contract requiring caller-supplied trusted reverse direction, TunnelKey/generation/epoch/PN scope before AuthenticatedReceipt or process-global batch grant settlement; stale/forward/cross-lane input never refunds an old repair or advances ACK. No cryptographic admission constructor, driver syscall or peer delivery inference.
roles.done_when: Own source compiled-once native r2_ deterministic MonoNs tests covering two tunnels both directions, stale epoch/rotation, ACK before grant, NotSent original epoch, Uncertain conservative debit, duplicate out-of-order receipt and 32/33 batch, retaining previous33/33 tests, own evidence S/H Governance.

roles.name: 编码与数据保护
roles.goal: R1-M3-FEC-MULTISCOPE-012: Strengthen existing FecOrigin test-only typed post-AEAD gate with two concurrently isolated trusted scopes under fake time: per-tunnel and direction replay/BlockID floors and Heavy/Compact expiry cannot contaminate peers, even after rekey and old parity. NO production origin constructor; no Go handshake/ABI/root edits.
roles.done_when: Own SOURCE compiled-once native r1_ tests for two tunnels both directions, 32-bit BlockID wrap, misrouted true AEAD ciphertext, replay and exhausted caps, PNs independent, deterministic timers and 56B oracle, retaining previous85/85, evidence S/cursor-only H Governance; live Go V4 provenance remains NOT_RUN.

roles.name: 平台与产品接入
roles.goal: R1-M4-AF_PACKET-PREFLIGHT-006: Implement narrowly cfg-gated Linux AF_PACKET capability and FD ownership preflight within wbd-platform, retaining unprivileged UDP sendmmsg/recvmmsg fixtures unchanged. Validate interface index, protocol/packet_type, MTU and owned borrowing lifetimes; on missing CAP_NET_RAW return typed EPERM with no fake fallback, no live raw activation, no new Cargo dependency/root ABI.
roles.done_when: Own SOURCE native tests and unprivileged Linux capability-negative cases with exact errno and rollback/close; classifier and lifecycle tests for bad iface/truncation/stop/generation, preserve42/42 previous native tests, evidence S/H Governance. Do not claim AF_PACKET data exchange or live TCP unless an exact privileged fixture is separately authorized and executed.
